dedupe_keys.name: eplusr r toolkit for the energyplus whole building simulation program

description: eplusr is an R package that gives a toolkit for working with EnergyPlus, the whole building simulation program. It lets users navigate and modify EnergyPlus models from code and makes parametric simulations and analysis of their results much less painful, so that building models can be driven from R scripts alongside statistics and plotting. It is written by Hongyuan Jia and Adrian Chong; version 0.17.0 was published on CRAN on 20 June 2026. Coverage: any building described as an EnergyPlus model. Access: free on CRAN and GitHub. Licence: MIT. Caveats: needs a local EnergyPlus install, and each package version supports a range of EnergyPlus versions. Simulation uses are parametric and sensitivity studies, calibration, retrofit and future weather runs of building energy and indoor temperature at scale. Related records: EnergyPlus and BESOS.
name: eplusr: R toolkit for the EnergyPlus whole building simulation program
outputs: EnergyPlus simulation results read back into R
